editorial: Imagine a life marred by envy until a single audition changes everything. In this absurdist superhero dramedy, the protagonist lands a lead role as Badman, yet every scene is delivered through silent, expressive gestures that challenge conventional storytelling. Joaquin Phoenix, himself a master of understated intensity, carries each moment with almost no dialogue, turning the film into a meditation on fame. However, the pacing lags after the first act, leaving you waiting for momentum. If you relish moments that mix sharp satire with a quiet, cinematic heartbeat, you will find this film oddly refreshing.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
